bp_intro: Four complete page compositions. Choose a flow, adapt the content, and keep your own product identity.
bp_demo_notice: Local examples only · All brands and records below are fictional. Actions change this preview in memory, reset on reload, and never call a database, payment or AI service. These are optional compositions, not configured product features.
bp_product_nav: A brief, from idea to next step.
bp_product_headline: Give a good idea a clear starting point.
bp_product_body: Before the task list grows, agree on who you are helping and what should happen next. Fieldnote turns three short answers into a brief you can review.
bp_no_account: No account needed for this preview.
bp_preview_title: A quiet place for reading notes
bp_preview_body: For readers who want to find the idea they highlighted last week.
bp_preview_one: Capture one note without leaving your reading flow.
bp_preview_two: Find it again by topic or a remembered phrase.
bp_preview_three: Start with notes; sharing can wait.
bp_features_title: Less ambiguity. A better first step.
bp_feature_one_body: Name the audience and the situation before listing features. A specific reader makes the page easier to write.
bp_feature_two_body: Put the intended outcome next to the idea. Compare proposed features with that outcome as the project develops.
bp_feature_three_body: Read the brief as one page. Missing decisions are easier to spot before they become implementation work.
bp_step_one_body: Use a short working title. You can change it later.
bp_step_two_body: Write who needs it and the situation they face.
bp_step_three_body: Say what the person should be able to do next.
bp_form_body: Try the full interaction below. Your answers appear together for review, without leaving this page.
bp_no_ai: This demonstration formats your answers directly. It does not use AI, save an account record or create a project.
bp_brief_ready: Your brief is ready for review · not saved
bp_faq_one: Does this preview save my answers?
bp_faq_one_body: No. Answers stay in this page’s memory and disappear on reload. A real product needs its own persistence and privacy rules.
bp_faq_two: Do I need an AI account?
bp_faq_two_body: No. The example is a regular form and result view. Aster does not require AI for ordinary web products.
bp_faq_three: Can I use a different layout or brand?
bp_faq_three_body: Yes. Reuse individual sections when they support your product’s story. The sample brand, green accent and section order are not requirements.
bp_footer_cta: A small, clear brief is enough to begin.
bp_resource_one: A small notebook for capturing a thought and finding it again by topic.
bp_resource_two: A reading index that connects a question with the notes behind it.
bp_resource_three: A focused queue for choosing one next step instead of collecting more tasks.
bp_resource_four: A draft workspace for comparing an outline with the version you are editing.
bp_article_notice: This is a fictional resource and an example reading page. No external service, download or endorsement is provided.
bp_article_overview_body: A useful detail page explains who the resource is for, what problem it addresses, and what the reader can do next. Keep supporting material near the claim it helps explain.
bp_article_step_one: Start with one concrete task and identify the result you need.
bp_article_step_two: Check the workflow, limits and data handling before choosing a tool.
bp_article_step_three: Try a small example and verify the result, including the failure path.
bp_article_limits_body: This preview demonstrates structure and navigation only. In your product, replace it with verified descriptions, real content and clearly attributed sources. Add outbound links only when a real destination exists.
bp_directory_headline: Find something worth a closer look.
bp_directory_body: Browse a category, search a phrase, then read the details before deciding.
bp_directory_note: Four fictional resources demonstrate editorial rows, classification, reading pages and a temporary contribution flow.

shop_sample_notice: Fictional products and prices · no orders or payments
shop_headline: Small things. More room for everyday life.
shop_intro: A catalog composition with room for the product: a clear image, a useful description, and a direct next step.
shop_collection_title: Find a place for something useful.
shop_organizer_body: A fictional wooden organizer, illustrated to demonstrate a large product image and a short product description.
shop_lamp_body: A fictional reading lamp. Use verified material, dimensions and safety information in a real catalog.
shop_bag_body: A fictional fabric bag, shown as an illustration. No real inventory or shipping promise is implied.

shop_detail_body: A real product page needs accurate images, material and size, delivery conditions, returns and an actual purchase flow. This example provides page structure only.

shop_empty: No sample products match. Try another search.
shop_about_title: Space for the object. Clarity for the person.

shop_faq: Can visitors pay on this example page?
shop_faq_body: No. Theme selection does not enable commerce. Real selling needs its own product data, order logic and an approved payment integration.
